currentIndexes.name: runs_returned_inputs
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runs_returned_inputs ON public.runs USING btree (tenant_id, session_id, input_return_request_id, mailbox_position) WHERE (input_return_request_id IS NOT NULL)

currentIndexes.name: runs_pkey
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_pkey ON public.runs USING btree (id)

currentIndexes.name: runs_tenant_id_id_unique
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_tenant_id_id_unique ON public.runs USING btree (tenant_id, id)

currentIndexes.name: runs_tenant_turn_unique
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_tenant_turn_unique ON public.runs USING btree (tenant_id, turn_id)

currentIndexes.name: runs_session_idempotency_unique
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_session_idempotency_unique ON public.runs USING btree (session_id, idempotency_key)

currentIndexes.name: runs_tenant_session_created_idx
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runs_tenant_session_created_idx ON public.runs USING btree (tenant_id, session_id, created_at)

currentIndexes.name: runs_tenant_trace_unique
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_tenant_trace_unique ON public.runs USING btree (tenant_id, trace_id)

currentIndexes.name: runs_tenant_session_turn_id_unique
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_tenant_session_turn_id_unique ON public.runs USING btree (tenant_id, session_id, turn_id, id)

currentIndexes.name: runs_unsealed_prefix
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runs_unsealed_prefix ON public.runs USING btree (output_first_topic, output_first_partition, output_first_offset) WHERE ((output_sealed_at IS NULL) AND (output_first_offset IS NOT NULL))

currentIndexes.name: runs_active_idx
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runs_active_idx ON public.runs USING btree (state, updated_at) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'running'::text, 'settling'::text, 'cancel_requested'::text]))

currentIndexes.name: runs_ready_queue_idx
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runs_ready_queue_idx ON public.runs USING btree (available_at, queued_at, id) WHERE ((state = 'queued'::text) AND (ready_at IS NOT NULL))

currentIndexes.name: runs_one_ready_lane
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_one_ready_lane ON public.runs USING btree (session_id) WHERE ((state = 'queued'::text) AND (ready_at IS NOT NULL))

currentIndexes.name: runs_owner_active
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runs_owner_active ON public.runs USING btree (sandbox_id) WHERE ((lease_id IS NOT NULL) AND (execution_released_at IS NULL))

currentIndexes.name: runs_agent_queue_idx
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runs_agent_queue_idx ON public.runs USING btree (agent_revision_id, available_at, queued_at, id) WHERE ((state = 'queued'::text) AND (ready_at IS NOT NULL))

currentIndexes.name: runs_active_lease
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runs_active_lease ON public.runs USING btree (lease_id) WHERE ((lease_id IS NOT NULL) AND (execution_released_at IS NULL))

currentIndexes.name: runs_pending_steer
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runs_pending_steer ON public.runs USING btree (queued_steer_id) WHERE ((state = 'queued'::text) AND (queued_steer_id IS NOT NULL))

currentIndexes.name: runs_pending_inputs_session
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runs_pending_inputs_session ON public.runs USING btree (tenant_id, session_id, mailbox_position) WHERE (state = 'queued'::text)

currentIndexes.name: runs_session_mailbox_unique
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_session_mailbox_unique ON public.runs USING btree (session_id, mailbox_position)

currentIndexes.name: sessions_pkey
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_pkey ON public.sessions USING btree (id)

currentIndexes.name: sessions_tenant_id_id_unique
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_tenant_id_id_unique ON public.sessions USING btree (tenant_id, id)

currentIndexes.name: sessions_visible_activity_page
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX sessions_visible_activity_page ON public.sessions USING btree (tenant_id, last_active_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE ((session_kind = 'conversation'::text) AND (pruned_at IS NULL))

currentIndexes.name: sessions_conversation_parent_idx
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX sessions_conversation_parent_idx ON public.sessions USING btree (tenant_id, conversation_parent_session_id, created_at) WHERE (conversation_parent_session_id IS NOT NULL)

currentIndexes.name: turns_pkey
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX turns_pkey ON public.turns USING btree (id)

currentIndexes.name: turns_tenant_session_id_unique
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX turns_tenant_session_id_unique ON public.turns USING btree (tenant_id, session_id, id)

currentIndexes.name: turns_session_id_id_unique
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX turns_session_id_id_unique ON public.turns USING btree (session_id, id)

currentIndexes.name: turns_one_active_per_session
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX turns_one_active_per_session ON public.turns USING btree (session_id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['dispatching'::text, 'running'::text, 'waiting_approval'::text, 'cancelling'::text]))

currentIndexes.name: turns_queued_mailbox_order
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX turns_queued_mailbox_order ON public.turns USING btree (session_id, created_at, id) WHERE (state = 'queued'::text)

currentIndexes.name: turns_tenant_unsettled
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX turns_tenant_unsettled ON public.turns USING btree (tenant_id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'dispatching'::text, 'running'::text, 'waiting_approval'::text, 'cancelling'::text]))

currentIndexes.name: turns_visible_session_idx
currentIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX turns_visible_session_idx ON public.turns USING btree (tenant_id, session_id, created_at) WHERE (pruned_at IS NULL)
